import json

CAT = {}

def add(cat, words):
    for w in words.split():
        CAT[w] = cat

add("color", "maroon blue pink cyan black white gray brown magenta violet crimson green teal yellow indigo")
add("opinion", "lovely silly good awful terrible ridiculous repulsive nice wonderful mysterious")
add("origin", "russian thai vietnamese bangladeshi japanese ethiopian iranian turkish american pakistani "
              "mexican chinese brazilian egyptian indian german nigerian filipino")
add("shape", "rectangular spherical circular pyramidal triangular square prismlike")
add("size", "huge large massive enormous tiny midsize medium-size normal-size small")
add("purpose", "hiking typing driving whittling eating drinking snorkeling walking smoking exercise")
add("material", "wool plastic steel paper cardboard glass leather cloth wood rubber iron fiberglass")
add("age", "old old-fashioned ancient archaic new brand-new")

# Total order inferred from the givens. Color and opinion always lead in the
# givens, and the rest follow the chain origin < shape < size < purpose < material < age.
ORDER = ["color", "opinion", "origin", "shape", "size", "purpose", "material", "age"]
RANK = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(ORDER)}

def ranks(phrase):
    return [RANK[CAT[w]] for w in phrase.split() if w in CAT]

def in_order(phrase):
    r = ranks(phrase)
    return all(a <= b for a, b in zip(r, r[1:]))

# Evidence sentences from the givens: each must be in order, or the inferred order is wrong.
evidence = [
    "lovely canvas", "huge box", "silly calculator", "paper ancient bag", "maroon good bottle",
    "bangladeshi spherical spoon", "triangular large new house", "medium-size hiking plate",
    "iranian eating glass screwdriver", "blue wonderful clock", "cloth old candle",
    "wood ancient piano", "drinking sunglasses", "glass archaic screwdriver",
    "pink car key", "leather old-fashioned wallet", "violet nice sunglasses",
]
evidence_ok = all(in_order(s) for s in evidence)

options = {
    "A": "massive hiking wool old-fashioned green silly marker",
    "B": "repulsive midsize typing plastic brand-new pyramidal ethiopian sofa",
    "C": "ethiopian rectangular medium-size driving glass ancient repulsive wallet",
    "D": "turkish circular massive whittling cardboard old yellow lovely fork",
    "E": "japanese prismlike small eating paper old-fashioned indigo table",
    "F": "massive typing paper old-fashioned ridiculous gray bottle",
    "G": "pyramidal medium-size drinking steel new pink ridiculous fire extinguisher",
    "H": "violet lovely enormous hiking leather new triangular wallet",
    "I": "terrible brown normal-size typing glass old triangular japanese necklace",
    "J": "bangladeshi prismlike huge drinking wood ancient umbrella",
}

results = {k: in_order(v) for k, v in options.items()}
correct = [k for k in sorted(results) if results[k]]
final_answer = "".join(correct) if correct else "K"

print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": final_answer,
    "evidence": {
        "order": ORDER,
        "evidence_sentences_consistent": evidence_ok,
        "option_ranks": {k: ranks(v) for k, v in options.items()},
        "option_correct": results,
    },
}))
